#SmartThings #CareInsight #FamilyCare

This is the official video guide on how to use SmartThings Family Care.👱‍♀️‍👱‍♂️

Notice changes before they become bigger concerns. 🏠

Care Insight is a SmartThings Family Care feature that keeps an eye on your parent's home environment and daily routine. If their device usage changes compared to the previous week, it sends you a message asking you to take a closer look. It also alerts you when the temperature or humidity falls outside the optimal range.

Let's get started with the SmartThings app on your smartphone 😊

Try now: https://www.smartthings.com/applink?action=service&service_code=FAMILY_CARE&clear_task=false
